text: Every pick needs a real Hard Rock price of -200 or better. Plus money is fine.
We only pick when our chance is at least 62% after a safety cut, and beats the price's break-even.
Player props are the core: full game and 1st half. Sides and totals only when the edge is clear.
1st half spreads show DraftKings numbers for reference. They are never picks.
Each pick says how settled it is: Early, Injury report in, or Inactives confirmed.
A pick is pulled if the player is out or limited, the price goes past -200, or the line is gone.
Parlays are 2 or 3 legs from the top picks, each leg in a different game.
Picks lock at kickoff. Results come from the official stats once the game is final.
The Record grades every pick at the price posted, 1 unit each. Pulled picks are graded too and shown as pulled.
